media: 1440x1080 HEVC 60 fps, AAC 44.1 kHz stereo, 38.754 s
method: Hand-labelled from 30 fps contact sheets (every 3rd frame, contact/), then frame-exact strips around each transition (frames/). Each cut is the first frame (0-based, setpts=PTS-STARTPTS,fps=30) where the previous shot is gone. Labelled before any app analysis of this reference.

scoring: One-to-one match within 2 frames of the cut, or anywhere from the cut to new_shot_from + 2 for flash transitions. Detections within 2 frames of an uncertain frame are ignored (neither true nor false positives).
